ref: ADR-0008 "JSON Schema and WSDL" (an array property records that it is one, whatever its maxItems) and "JSON as a source at run time" (an array property reads each item as one occurrence, by its array marker and never by its maximum); #118
note: PO message mappings have no JSON source, so the reading is decided. $/one is an array with maxItems 1, so it is an array property at 0..1: its one item a is one occurrence of one, in the root's one context, and All is a. Read by its maximum, one would be a leaf, the array would read as absent and no All would be written.
